desc: American Tactical's RUKX Gear bags are designed to allow the wearer to be able to efficiently access their gear on the go along with having a comfortable carry. RUXK Gear is manufactured for a maximum durability. These packs will keep your equipment protected from the harshest environments. Compact pack provides ideal blend of capacity and transportability with compact design and 4 main storage areas. Premium back- relief panel design for maximum comfort during extended use. Internal organization system for securing tools and other items. Reinforced Velcro webbing and heavy-duty non-rust zippers. Hydration-pack compatible.
